promptSuffix: Design intentional large hair masses with coherent roots and directional flow; avoid repeating identical curls, spaghetti strands and uniform highlights. Preserve the character's established hairstyle. Clothing must have intelligible tailoring, seams and functional attachment points; remove floating straps, redundant buckles and arbitrary filigree. Use distinct character-specific faces, restrained expressions, clear silhouettes, controlled cel shading and material-specific folds. Keep costume construction consistent across views and motion. No random noise to imitate handcraft.
runtimePolicy: Keep existing assets until a replacement set is reviewed. A prompt policy does not certify generated output. Record unresolved defects and runtimeApplied separately.
